provenance.statement: Every headline, standfirst, outlet, and timestamp here is authored, not scraped. No entry asserts anything about a real published article. Company names and tickers are real because the fixture has to exercise Phase 0 symbols; the events are invented and must not be quoted or cited as claims about any company.
provenance.why_synthetic: Issue #72's DoD asks for AC-4 demonstrated on three *real* ticker-days of varying volume. Real ticker-days need I2 (#61) and I3 (#62) for ingestion and #57 for storage, none of which are on main. These three days are authored to the same shape - one canonical story per event, as M2 and M3 would leave them - so the clustering behaviour they demonstrate is the behaviour real days would exercise, but the numbers are not the DoD's numbers.

blocked_by.#57: I1 persistence - open; no stored trading days to replay

shape_notes: Three volumes on purpose: AAPL is below AC-4's clustering floor, NVDA is an ordinary day, TSLA is a heavy one. Each story is already canonical - duplicates and rewrites are M2's and M3's job and are deliberately absent, because clustering raw duplicates would let the size of a syndication burst decide the day's themes.

ticker_days.expectation: Below the four-story floor: no clustering, every story listed individually under other coverage.

stories.title: Apple opens its first store in Saudi Arabia
stories.description: The Riyadh location is the company's first owned store in the country.

stories.title: Apple wins dismissal of an App Store class action
stories.description: A federal judge dismissed the developer suit in full.

stories.title: Apple names a new head of hardware engineering
stories.description: The appointment takes effect next month.

ticker_days.expectation: An ordinary day: three recognisable strands - the quarterly result, the China export decision, and the GTC product news - plus a governance story that belongs to none of them.

stories.title: Nvidia reports record data centre revenue
stories.description: Quarterly revenue came in above analyst estimates on continued accelerator demand.

stories.title: Nvidia guides to higher data centre revenue next quarter
stories.description: Management pointed to accelerator bookings already on the books.

stories.title: Nvidia gross margin expands in the quarter
stories.description: Margin improved on a richer accelerator mix.

stories.title: Washington clears Nvidia to ship a reduced-performance chip to China
stories.description: The licence covers a scaled-back accelerator for Chinese buyers.

stories.title: China export licence for Nvidia accelerators draws Congressional scrutiny
stories.description: Two senators asked the Commerce Department to explain the export decision.

stories.title: Nvidia unveils its next accelerator generation at GTC
stories.description: The new parts ship to cloud customers later this year.

stories.title: Nvidia opens accelerator orders to European cloud providers at GTC
stories.description: European operators can order the new systems from today.

stories.title: Nvidia GTC keynote draws record developer attendance
stories.description: Organisers said registrations exceeded last year's conference.

stories.title: Nvidia adds two directors to its board
stories.description: Both appointments take effect at the annual meeting.

ticker_days.expectation: A heavy day with several strands running at once: deliveries and pricing, a safety recall, factory operations, the robotaxi programme, and energy storage, plus stories that sit outside all of them.

stories.title: Tesla delivers 495,000 vehicles in the first quarter
stories.description: Deliveries came in ahead of the consensus compiled by the company.

stories.title: Tesla quarterly deliveries top analyst estimates in China
stories.description: China volumes accounted for most of the beat.

stories.title: Tesla cuts Model 3 prices across Europe

stories.title: European Model Y buyers get a lower sticker price from Tesla
stories.description: The company trimmed prices on the crossover as well.

stories.title: Tesla recalls 12,000 Cybertrucks over a wiper fault

stories.title: Safety regulator opens a review of the Cybertruck wiper recall

stories.title: Tesla recalls Model Y vehicles over a seatbelt anchor

stories.title: Tesla's Berlin plant resumes output after a grid fault

stories.title: Tesla adds a third shift at the Berlin factory
stories.description: The plant will run around the clock from next month.

stories.title: Tesla plans a new battery line in Nevada

stories.title: Arizona regulators set a hearing date for the Tesla robotaxi application

stories.title: Tesla expands its supervised self-driving trial to two more states

stories.title: Tesla energy storage deployments set a quarterly record

stories.title: Tesla signs a grid storage contract with a European utility
stories.description: The contract covers Megapack deliveries over three years.

stories.title: Tesla's head of investor relations departs

stories.title: Tesla schedules its investor day for 2026-05-14

stories.title: Tesla opens a supercharger corridor across Norway
